description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app. It sets up a bottom navigation interface with fragments and includes a floating action button to initiate scanning functionality.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the entry point of the app that hosts the bottom navigation and floating action button for scanning documents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines behavior for navigation and scanning button.

methods.name: setupBottomNav
methods.description: Configures the bottom navigation view to switch between fragments based on user selection.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment in the container with the specified fragment.
